title: Teams audio dies a few minutes into every call until Teams is restarted

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: Teams audio drops out after a few minutes

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Every call this week goes the same way: fine for the first few minutes, then I
stop hearing anyone. They can still hear me. If I quit Teams and reopen it, it
works again for a while.

The headset is fine - music plays through it all day without a problem.

Mel

must_include.what: Quit Teams entirely and clear the Teams cache folder
Run the test call and check which devices are selected

must_not_include.what: Gives a macOS cache path; she is on Windows
Blames a Microsoft outage on a single user's calls

characteristics: Names the Windows cache path, because she is on a Windows laptop
Does not send her to buy a headset: the headset demonstrably works

rationale: Restarting the client fixes it for a while, which is the cache step of the Teams runbook, and the headset works outside Teams so the device selection is a check rather than the cause. She can still work, so P3 (G1). The general 'laptop running slowly' runbook shares 'after a few minutes' and 'restart' and would send her to Task Manager instead (G10). She is on the Windows laptop on record, so the Windows path in the runbook is the right one to quote - the mirror of case-032, where the same path was wrong.
